scripts.start:web: if [ -n "${MAZE_ALLOW_TEST_HOOKS:-}${MAZE_TEST_SEED_SECRET:-}${MAZE_TUNING_FIXTURE:-}" ]; then echo 'start:web: refusing to start, a test-hook flag is set in the environment' >&2; exit 1; fi; pnpm --filter @maze/web start
scripts.sim:bench: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js bench
scripts.sim:exact: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js exact
scripts.sim:calibrate: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js calibrate
scripts.sim:certify: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js certify
scripts.sim:sensitivity: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js sensitivity
scripts.sim:stats: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js stats
scripts.tune: pnpm --filter @maze/sim build && nice -n 10 node packages/sim/dist/cli.js tune
